title: Enjoying the night
text:
Very interesting to get to know so many corners near the Alhambra, at night which gives it a special atmosphere, as was our case. 

The descent down the Cuesta de los Chinos was spectacular, as was the ascent up the Cuesta de Gomerez. 

Even being from here, I learned a lot of facts and locations unknown to me.
